$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for a vendor invoice that carries field tickets behind it. JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number printed in the header, exactly as printed.

vendor_name.description: Vendor issuing the invoice, exactly as printed.

afe_number.description: AFE number printed on the invoice, exactly as printed. Null if absent.

well_name.description: Well or property billed, exactly as printed.

line_items.description: One item per printed invoice row, in printed order. Every row references the ticket it came from.

ticket_ref.description: Ticket number the row references, exactly as printed.

quantity.description: Quantity printed on the row. Digits only.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed on the row, exactly as printed.

rate.description: Unit rate printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed rate even when it differs from a rate you would expect.

amount.description: Extended amount printed on the row. Digits only. Copy the printed amount; never recompute it.

total.description: Invoice total as printed. Digits only. Copy the printed total; never sum the rows yourself.
